parsed.post: Significant gain from increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 (val_bpb 1.1049 -> 1.0165). Capacity seems to be a major bottleneck within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to further improve capacity/resolution, while keeping the depth gains.
parsed.description: Increasing capacity further by increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 on top of the new DEPTH=6 baseline.
